text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions, upside breakouts of multi-day highs (donchian_breakout 24/48/144 h), ATR-channel breakouts and persistent positive EMA slope (ema_slope span 48) are followed by 4-24 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost; optionally only in high short-term vol (vol_regime 0.67) or above the 1-week EMA (trend_regime_1h 168).
rationale: Mechanism M3 (mechanisms.md) extended to multi-hour horizons: volatility clustering plus slow information diffusion and trend-following flows (CTA/retail momentum chasing, stop and short-liquidation cascades on derivatives venues spilling into KRW spot) make multi-day highs and persistent EMA slopes continue over 4-24 h (time-series momentum). Counterparty: stop orders and liquidated shorts at breakout levels, counter-trend limit sellers who fade new highs, and late retail chasers we sell to on exit. Why it persists: forced liquidations are price-insensitive; trend capacity at hours horizon is large and crowded-out by nobody on a minor KRW venue. Kills it: long-only spot in bear regimes (2022), false breakouts in low vol, regime beta masquerading as signal (pitfall P-S6) - the matched (KST hour x vol) null removes unconditional drift only within the eligible pool. 5m version (camp-000003/6) was information-thin at 15-30 min (fact-000003, fact-000006, int-000004); re-examine condition 'decision interval changes' is met (15m/1h/4h engine added 2026-11-09). Filters: vol_regime(24,0.67) tests the M3 high-vol story; trend_regime_1h(168) (1-week EMA) is the regime-filtered-trend variant (hypothesis c). Evidence exposure: fact-000003/6 Dev only (lockbox none, Val none); K-P0-4 (lockbox+Val exposed) motivates the vol filter only, its value is the block default/grid value, not derived from it. Scope: Coinone BTC-KRW, decision 1h (and 4h screen), coinone_conservative primary cost, upbit_conservative grade cost; long only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs (incl. prior family screens), n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (bar-minute preset). Reported, not gating: upbit_conservative net (grade A/B) and per-year excess (pre-registered side calculation).

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 15m decisions, closes far below the rolling mean (bollinger_z_revert window 24/96, z 2.5) are followed by 1-4 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost, with and without a 1h trend filter (trend_regime_1h 24) or a 1-week bull-regime filter (trend_regime_1h 168), and the excess is not concentrated in one Dev year.
rationale: Mechanism M4 (mechanisms.md): forced liquidations / panic selling push KRW spot below fair value and partially rebound once the price-insensitive flow ends. Counterparty: force-liquidated levered longs and panic-selling retail; liquidity provision during cascades carries inventory risk most participants avoid. Kills it: information-driven drops, second-wave cascades, bear regimes. This re-examines the family at 15m/1h decisions (re-examine condition 'decision interval changes' in fact-000005/fact-000008) and explicitly tests int-000005 (unverified): that the 5m trend-filtered reversion is bull-regime dip buying concentrated in 2021 rather than liquidity-provision income. trend_regime_1h(168) (1-week EMA) is a slow bull-regime filter: the matched null is drawn from the same filtered pool, so a filter-only (regime beta) effect does not count as signal. Pre-registered diagnostic (side calculation, no ledger): for every passing config, per-calendar-year excess at the best primary horizon; int-000005 is supported at this timeframe if the excess is positive in fewer than 3 of the 5 Dev years or one year carries > 50% of the summed excess. Evidence exposure: fact-000004/5/8 and the camp-000008 ad-hoc robustness are Dev only (lockbox none, Val none). Scope: Coinone BTC-KRW, decision 15m and 1h, coinone_conservative primary, upbit_conservative grade; long only.

text: Coinone BTC-KRW 1h: atr_channel_breakout(span 24, mult 3) taken only when 24h realised vol is in the upper half / tercile of its trailing range (vol_regime(24, 0.5 / 0.67)), with ATR exits (SL 2/3 ATR x TP 1.5/3 ATR, max hold 480 min = information horizon), earns positive coinone_conservative net returns that pass G0-G5 on Dev and the robustness suite (incl. regime share <= 70%).
rationale: Mechanism M3 (multi-hour time-series momentum; in high vol, breakouts trigger stop/short-liquidation cascades and trend-following flow). Counterparty: stops and counter-trend sellers at breakout levels, late chasers we sell to at exit; persists because liquidation flow is forced and Coinone is too thin for large arbitrageurs. Kills it: bear regimes for a long-only spot book, Upbit-level costs (grade B), false breakouts in high vol. Evidence (all Dev; lockbox none, Val none): screen camp-000015 (fact-000015) passed both configs: vol 0.5 n=850 p=3e-4 net +33.3 bp @480 (Upbit +19.3), vol 0.67 n=678 p=6e-4 net +39.0 bp (Upbit +25.0), info horizon 480 peaked; exit suggestions TP 1.38-1.40 ATR, SL 1.80-1.86 ATR. Motivation from camp-000013 Dev robustness only (up-trend 30d days 74% of PnL; high-vol tercile stronger); the G6 outcome of camp-000013 is NOT used. Exits are held identical to camp-000013 (SL 2/3 x TP 1.5/3 ATR, hold 480) so that the only change vs camp-000013 is the vol filter (isolates the filter; the set brackets the screen suggestions). Logged side calculation camp-000016 (9 configs, Dev): excess at 480 by trailing-30d trend tercile: unfiltered down 33.9 bp z 2.83 / sideways 27.3 z 2.41 / up 27.5 z 2.44; vol0.5 25.3 z 1.71 / 41.2 z 3.04 / 31.8 z 2.24; vol0.67 13.3 z 0.79 / 40.1 z 2.63 / 44.4 z 2.66. The grid was fixed before this side calculation and not changed by it. Pre-stated expectation / predicted failure modes: robustness regime share (up-trend) and G4 recent-12-month Sharpe (2025 weak in every momentum config); the vol filter thins down-regime events, so REGIME_DEPENDENT remains the most likely failure; G5 margin is thin (required Sharpe 1.29 vs camp-000013 Sharpe 1.46).
success_criteria: At least one spec passes G0-G6 and the Dev robustness suite (latency, outliers, leave-year-out, cost x1.5, regime share <= 70%, alpha, cross-venue). Refuted for this filter if the best Dev Sharpe_w is not above camp-000013 representative (1.02) or the regime check still fails.

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions, a rise of >= 100 bp over the last 3 h or 12 h (roc_threshold) is followed by 4-24 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null net of coinone_conservative cost, and more so when the decision bar's volume is abnormally high vs its trailing 2-day distribution (volume_z(48) >= 1 / >= 2).
rationale: Mechanism: volume-return dynamics (Campbell-Grossman-Wang 1993; Llorente-Michaely-Saar-Wang 2002), an M3 variant: price moves on abnormal volume carry informed, forced (liquidation / stop) or trend-following flow and continue; moves on normal volume are more often liquidity noise. Counterparty: counter-trend limit sellers and liquidity providers absorbing directional flow at the impulse, and late chasers we sell to at exit; persists because liquidation flow is price-insensitive and Coinone is too thin for large arbitrageurs. What kills it: Coinone volume is contaminated by bot prints (pitfalls P-D1, venues V-1; lockbox none, Val none) so volume_z may be noise; long-only bear regimes; Upbit-level cost (grade B); the effect may be nothing but the generic 1h momentum already known (fact-000009, fact-000015; Dev, lockbox none, Val none). Pre-registered contrast: the volume filter adds information only if a filtered config passes AND its matched-null excess at its best primary horizon exceeds that of the unfiltered sibling with the same lookback. A strategy campaign is run ONLY for a passing volume-filtered config that meets this contrast; if only unfiltered roc configs pass, no strategy campaign (that is the generic 1h momentum line paused in cycle 3A). All parameter values are block-grid values; nothing was computed on data before registration.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (240/480/1440). Volume-confirmation claim supported only if a volume_z config passes and its excess > the unfiltered same-lookback config's excess.

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions at the KST morning (decision hour 09/10 KST, session_kst asia_open), an overnight rise of >= 100 bp over the last 12 h / 24 h is followed by 4-24 h returns above a matched null drawn from the same morning hours, net of coinone_conservative cost, and this excess is larger than for the same entry at the US open (placebo, us_open) and than the unfiltered roc(12,100) config of screen c3c_vol_breakout_roc_volz_1h.
rationale: Mechanism (M2, directional variant argued here): the marginal participant on KRW venues is Korean retail, largely inactive KST 02-08 while the US session moves price. Attention-constrained investors react with a lag (Barber-Odean 2008 attention-driven buying) when they return in the KST morning, so an overnight up-move is followed by domestic buying pressure during 09-13 KST that lifts KRW prices (and the KRW premium) for hours. Counterparty: late domestic retail buyers who chase the overnight move after our entry and to whom we sell; persists because attention limits are behavioural and KRW capital controls slow offshore arbitrage of the premium (M5). What kills it: the marginal KRW buyer is now bots / institutions; the excess is generic hourly momentum (placebo and unfiltered contrasts); cost; bear regimes for a long-only book. Evidence: K-P0-3 (KST 09 volume/volatility concentration; lockbox exposed, Val exposed) motivates the session only and sets no grid value; fact-000009 (Dev, lockbox none, Val none) shows generic 1h momentum information, which is exactly the confound the contrasts test. Pre-registered contrast: the attention claim is supported only if an asia_open config passes AND its excess at its best primary horizon exceeds both the us_open placebo's excess and the unfiltered roc(12,100) excess of screen S1. A strategy campaign is run only if this holds. Block-grid values only (session names are the block's presets); nothing computed on data before registration.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (240/480/1440); attention claim additionally requires asia_open excess > us_open placebo excess and > unfiltered roc(12,100) excess.

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 15m decisions, closes >= 2.5 sd below the 24-bar (6 h) mean on abnormally high volume (volume_z(96) >= 1 / >= 2 vs the trailing day) - the price+volume proxy for liquidation cascades in mechanisms.md M4 - are followed by 30-120 min returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost, with larger excess than the unfiltered bollinger_z_revert(24, 2.5) of screen camp-000011.
rationale: Mechanism M4: forced liquidation of levered longs creates price-insensitive selling that partly reverts once the pressure ends; liquidity providers are paid for absorbing it. mechanisms.md M4 names the proxy explicitly (sharp drop z-score + volume z-score spike), which no prior screen used: camp-000004/camp-000011/camp-000012 tested price-only dislocations. Counterparty: force-liquidated longs and panic sellers; persists because providing liquidity into cascades carries inventory risk most avoid. What kills it: information-driven drops (no reversion), second-wave cascades, bear regimes; Coinone volume contaminated by bot prints (P-D1, V-1; lockbox none, Val none), which may make volume_z a poor cascade proxy (Upbit volume is not available as a block). Evidence (Dev, lockbox none, Val none): fact-000011 (15m bollinger(24,2.5) unfiltered passed, info horizon 30 min, net +4.9 bp at 240 min); fact-000012 (1h price-only reversion NO_SIGNAL). Primary horizons 30/60/120 are set from fact-000011's information horizon (30 min) instead of the 15m preset; int-000005 / int-000008 are unverified and not used as facts. Pre-registered: a strategy campaign only if a config passes AND its excess exceeds fact-000011's unfiltered excess at the same horizon AND the plausible Sharpe (net mean x event frequency) clears the power requirement. Block-grid values only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (30/60/120); cascade claim additionally requires excess above the unfiltered camp-000011 config.

text: On Coinone BTC-KRW at 1h decisions, closes >= 2.5 sd below the 24 h mean on abnormally high volume (volume_z(48) >= 1 / >= 2 vs the trailing 2 days) are followed by 4-24 h returns above a matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of coinone_conservative cost, unlike the price-only 1h reversion that was NO_SIGNAL (camp-000012).
rationale: Same mechanism M4 and counterparty as S3a (force-liquidated longs, panic sellers; volume spike as the cascade proxy named in mechanisms.md M4). At 1h a cascade bar is a larger, rarer dislocation; the question is whether volume confirmation isolates the forced-selling events whose reversion lasts hours, which price-only 1h dislocations did not show (fact-000012 NO_SIGNAL, Dev, lockbox none, Val none). Kills: information-driven drops, second waves, bear regimes, bot-contaminated Coinone volume (P-D1). Expected weak a priori (fact-000012, int-000008 unverified). Strategy campaign only if a config passes and the plausible Sharpe clears the power requirement. Block-grid values only.
success_criteria: Per config: BH q=0.10 over the family's screen configs, n_events >= 300, coinone_conservative net mean > 0 at the best primary horizon (240/480/1440).

text: Coinone BTC-KRW 1h: a >= 100 bp rise over 3 h or 12 h (roc_threshold) on abnormally high decision-bar volume (volume_z(48) >= 1), with ATR exits (SL 3 ATR x TP 2 / 4 ATR, max hold 1440 min = information horizon or 2880 min low-turnover variant), earns positive coinone_conservative net returns that pass G0-G5 on Dev and the robustness suite (incl. regime share <= 70%).
rationale: Mechanism: volume-return dynamics (M3 variant): impulses on abnormal volume carry informed / forced (liquidation, stop) / trend-following flow that continues; counterparty: counter-trend limit sellers and liquidity providers absorbing the flow, late chasers at exit. Kills: bot-contaminated Coinone volume (P-D1), long-only bear regimes, Upbit cost (grade B), generic momentum confound. Evidence (Dev only; lockbox none, Val none): screen camp-000020 (drv-000012): roc(3,100)&vz(48,1) n 981, p 0.058, excess 28.8 bp z 2.07 @1440, net +43.0 bp (Upbit +29.0); roc(12,100)&vz(48,1) n 1419, p 0.075, excess 24.3 bp z 1.96 @1440, net +37.3 bp (Upbit +23.3); both beat their unfiltered siblings (8.3 / 16.9 bp at 1440), so the pre-registered volume contrast is met. Info horizon 1440 (rising). Exit suggestions TP 2.19-2.20 ATR, SL 3.22-3.33 ATR -> SL fixed at 3 ATR, TP bracketing at 2 / 4 ATR, hold 1440 (info horizon) and 2880 (rising profile; low-turnover variant per pipeline_calibration.md). The min_z 2.0 configs (also passing, n 371 / 440) are excluded a priori on sample size: with 24 h holds and one position, G1 (>= 300 Dev trades, recent-12m minimum) would bind. Pre-stated expectations: plausible Sharpe from the screen is ~1.1-1.4 on excess (1.9-2.2 on net incl. drift, overlap ignored), i.e. near the DSR requirement and below the ~2 needed for Val; predicted failure modes: G2 (weak z ~2), regime share (long-only up-trend tilt), G4 recent 12 months, PBO. No side calculations were run.

text: On the fixed Coinone universe [BTC-KRW, XRP-KRW, ETH-KRW] (D15, pooled) at 5m decisions, sharp downside dislocations - close >= 2.5 sd below the 96-bar mean (bollinger_z_revert(96,2.5)) or an equal-weight reversion composite score >= 2.0 (composite_z reversion: -r_6, -boll_48, +log1p vol) - are followed by 30-120 min returns above a per-asset matched (KST hour x vol) null, net of per-asset coinone_conservative cost (D17).
rationale: Mechanism M4 (mechanisms.md, liquidity provision after forced/panic selling): short-horizon price-insensitive selling (liquidations, stop cascades, panic retail) pushes thin Coinone books below fair value and part of the move reverts once the pressure stops; a resting buyer is paid for supplying immediacy. Counterparty: forced-liquidated leveraged longs and panic sellers hitting thin Coinone bids, especially in the alt books (XRP/ETH) where Coinone depth is a fraction of Upbit's (data_audit_multi_20261110: Coinone/Upbit KRW volume XRP 3-10 %, ETH 3-18 %). Why it persists: Coinone alt books are too small for large market makers; the 0 % fee is recent. What kills it: information-driven drops that do not revert and second waves (falling knives; Dev 2022 bear), per-asset spread cost (D17: Coinone RT XRP 8/10/14, ETH 5/8/14 bp; XRP spread is one 1-KRW tick), adverse selection of maker fills at dip-buy signal times (fill_model_20261110: -2.5..-4.7 bp markout at 5 min, n=20, BTC, Forward data; lockbox none, Val none), Upbit-level cost (grade B). What is new vs prior BTC-only liq_meanrev work: the fixed 3-asset universe (D15, pooled, equal sleeves) roughly triples independent-ish events with zero extra parameters, per-asset cost models (D17) and the purpose of the screen: it gates a pre-planned maker scale-in ladder campaign (D16, user request 'buy a part on a dip, buy more on a further dip, sell on small rises'), so the entry trigger must first show information on the pooled universe. text: Coinone 3-asset universe [BTC-KRW, XRP-KRW, ETH-KRW] (D15, pooled, equal sleeves), 5m: after bollinger_z_revert(96,2.5) a maker scale-in ladder (first tranche market, 3-4 equal tranches with limit rungs every 0.5/1.0 ATR below, maker take-profit 2.5 ATR per tranche or on average cost, aggregate stop 1.5 ATR below the last rung, max hold 120 min) earns positive per-asset coinone_conservative net MTM returns that pass G0-G5 on Dev, beat the ladder-matched random-entry null and pass the binding tail check.
rationale: Mechanism M4 liquidity provision (mechanisms.md): forced/panic selling pushes thin Coinone books (esp. XRP/ETH) below fair value and part of it reverts; a resting buyer that adds on further dips is paid for immediacy. Counterparty: liquidated longs / panic sellers hitting thin bids. Kills: falling knives (2022 bear), information-driven drops, adverse selection of maker rungs (fill_model_20261110: -2.5..-4.7 bp at 5 min at dip signal times, n=20, BTC Forward; lockbox none, Val none), per-asset spread (D17), Upbit cost (grade B). Design (user request, D16: 'buy a part on a dip, buy more on a further dip, sell on small rises'), fixed in scratchpad PLAN_prescreen.txt BEFORE the screens ran: first tranche = market at the screened decision; equal tranches max_exposure/N (N in {3,4}), rungs every step_atr in {0.5,1.0} x decision-bar ATR14 below the first fill as maker limit orders (conservative 1-tick trade-through fill rule), maker take-profit limits; exit mode gridded {per_tranche (sell each tranche on a small rise), average (sell all at average cost + TP)}; mandatory aggregate stop sl_atr 1.5 ATR below the LAST rung (max loss fixed at ladder start); max_exposure 1.0 per sleeve. A limit first entry was dropped because entry 2 + exits 3 + ladder 2 + exit-mode grid 1 + offset 1 = 9 > MAX_PARAMS 8 (the user-requested per_tranche-vs-average comparison was kept). TP = screen MFE-median ATR suggestion rounded to 0.25, max hold = information horizon. Gates use MTM daily returns (D18); the tail check is binding for ladders (D19). Evidence (Dev only; lockbox none, Val none): screen camp-000025 (drv-000017): pooled n 8942 (BTC 2999, XRP 3025, ETH 2918), p 0.004, excess 6.3 bp z 3.00 @120 (info horizon 120, peaked), net of taker round trip only +0.7 bp (Upbit -12.0); MFE median 2.48 ATR, |MAE| p75 4.71 ATR (5m ATR median 0.234 %). Plausible Sharpe: z/sqrt(4.83 y) = 1.37 on excess - a ceiling that needs maker execution to recover most of the taker cost; with taker cost it is ~0.15. Power: required 1.20 at N_dsr ~7 (target 1.35 = this ceiling). Predicted failure modes (stated before the run): G2 vs the ladder-matched null (the ladder structure, not the entry, may carry the PnL), net cost (XRP/ETH spreads), tail check 2022 / CVaR, G4 recent 12 months.
success_criteria: At least one spec passes G0-G5, ablation, G6 (outcome code) and the Dev robustness suite incl. the binding tail check. Refuted as a tradeable edge if no spec passes G2 vs the ladder-matched null or the best Dev Sharpe_w (MTM) < 1.0. Report per exit mode, per tranche count, per asset, fill rates, trades/day and 2022 results.
